facts.about: Bajaj Finance is mainly engaged in the business of lending. BFL has a diversified lending portfolio across retail, SME and commercial customers with a significant presence in urban and rural India. It also accepts public and corporate deposits and offers variety of financial services products to its customers.(Source : 202003 Annual Report Page No:124)

business.summary: Bajaj Finance Limited is a non-banking financial company engaged in financing activities with a diversified lending model, earning revenue through interest, fees, and investments from various lending segments.

guidance.statement: Deliver between 60 million to 62 million new loans in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are well on track to deliver between 60 million to 62 million new loans in FY27.

guidance.statement: Add between 18 MM to 20 MM customers to the franchise in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are clear about adding between 18 MM to 20 MM customers to the franchise in FY27.

guidance.statement: Deliver a 25 to 40 basis point improvement in FY27 on opex-to-NTI.
guidance.quote: We remain pretty comfortable place to deliver a 25 to 40 basis point improvement in FY27 on opex-to-NTI.

guidance.statement: End the year with close to 2,800 on stand-alone gold branches.
guidance.quote: and we remain quite clear about ending the year with close to 2,800 on stand-alone gold branches.

guidance.statement: Deliver between 26% and 27% growth on a full year basis.
guidance.quote: I would say probably between 26%, 27% growth we should deliver now on a full year basis.

guidance.statement: Maintain a medium-term guidance of 20% to 25%.
guidance.quote: So, that's the second point. On NIM, clearly, at this point in time, we are baking in two more increases in the current year that would take us to 6% kind of rates.

guidance.statement: Foresee 2,700 to 2,800 branches, or maybe 3,000, for gold loans by year-end
guidance.quote: By year-end we foresee 2,700 to 2,800 branches, all goes well, maybe 3,000 branches and AUM of between INR29,000 crores and INR31,000 crores, all organic.

guidance.statement: Foresee gold loan AUM between INR29,000 crores and INR31,000 crores by year-end
guidance.quote: By year-end we foresee 2,700 to 2,800 branches, all goes well, maybe 3,000 branches and AUM of between INR29,000 crores and INR31,000 crores, all organic.

guidance.statement: Confident of delivering 25 to 40 basis points improvement in opex to NTI
guidance.quote: Overall, we are confident of delivering 25 to 40 basis points improvement for FY '27 in opex to NTI.

guidance.statement: Gold loan portfolio to cross 5% of total AUM by FY27.
guidance.quote: We foresee gold loan portfolio to probably cross 5-odd percent of total AUM by FY'27.

guidance.statement: MSME growth to return to double digits between Q2 and Q3 of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect that it should come back to double-digit growth or the company growth momentum between Q2 and Q3 of FY'27.

guidance.statement: Captive 2-wheeler and 3-wheeler book will wind down to less than INR 1,500 crores by September 26.
guidance.quote: This book will principally just wind down to less than INR 1,500-odd crores by September '26...

guidance.statement: Expect to deploy 600-plus autonomous agents across operations, DMS, HR, technology and risk in FY27.
guidance.quote: In FY27, we expect to deploy 600-plus autonomous agents and across operations, DMS, HR, technology and risk.

guidance.statement: Confident of adding 15 - 17 million new customers in FY27.
guidance.quote: In terms of customer franchise, we continue to be confident of adding 15 - 17 million new customers in FY27.

guidance.statement: Confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: In terms of AUM, we're confident of a 20% to 24% AUM growth, aided by new businesses that we've launched in the last few years as they begin to scale.

guidance.statement: Expect to see continued improvement of 25 to 40 basis points in opex to NTI.
guidance.quote: On opex to NTI, we expect to see continued improvement of 25 to 40 basis points from current levels.

guidance.statement: Continue to guide for ROA of 4.4% to 4.6% in FY27.
guidance.quote: ROA came in as of fourth quarter at 4.6%. We continue to guide for 4.4% to 4.6%.

guidance.statement: Continue to guide for return on equity of 19% to 20%.
guidance.quote: Return on equity came in at 20% in the current quarter, we continue to guide for 19% to 20%.

scorecard.promised: Deliver between 26% and 27% growth on a full year basis for FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Revenue grew 22.8% YoY in Sep 2026, while FY26 revenue growth was 19.1%.
scorecard.evidence: Revenue growth accelerated from 18.6% in Jun 2026 to 22.8% in Sep 2026, nearing the 26% target.

scorecard.promised: Add between 18 MM to 20 MM customers to the franchise in FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Management previously targeted 15-17 million before revising the goal upward to 18-20 million.
scorecard.evidence: The target was raised from 15-17 million in Q4 FY26 to 18-20 million by Q2 FY27.

scorecard.promised: Deliver a 25 to 40 basis point improvement in FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Financing margins remained stable at 36% for the first two quarters of FY27.
scorecard.evidence: Margins improved from 33% in FY26 to 36% in H1 FY27, supporting the opex efficiency narrative.

scorecard.promised: End FY27 with close to 2,800 stand-alone gold branches.
scorecard.delivered: Management maintains a target of 2,700 to 3,000 branches by year-end.
scorecard.evidence: Guidance remains consistent across calls, targeting a significant footprint expansion by March 2027.

scorecard.promised: Wind down to less than INR 1,500 crores by September 2026.
scorecard.delivered: The wind-down was scheduled for completion by the Sep 2026 quarter-end.
scorecard.evidence: Management confirmed the wind-down timeline in Q4 FY26 for completion by Sep 2026.

narrative.scoreline: Management is aggressively scaling its gold loan and customer acquisition targets while successfully defending margins despite rising credit complexity.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: The worst of credit issues in MSME is behind the company by June 2026.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Gross NPA stood at 1.06% in Sep 2026, suggesting stable asset quality post-June.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Credit performance remained strong with loan loss improving to 1.54% versus 1.87% YoY.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Net profit grew 28% in Jun 2026, supporting the claim of strong credit-led profitability.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Stage 2 increase in gold loans was due to short-tenure schemes and is resolving.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Management reported 550 crores already resolved back to Stage 1 by the Q2 call.

bull: Revenue growth accelerated to 22.8% in Sep 2026, moving closer to the 26-27% full-year guidance.
Financing margins have expanded to 36% in H1 FY27 from 33% in the prior fiscal year.
Net profit reached a record ₹6,367 crore in Sep 2026, representing a 28% YoY increase.
bear: Management is raising capital via QIP despite a net worth of ₹1.23L crore, signaling high growth-related cash needs.
Negative free cash flow of ₹66,686 crore in FY26 highlights the heavy capital consumption of the lending model.
Gross NPA of 1.06% and Stage 2 gold loan spikes suggest underlying pressure in specific retail segments.
watch: Gold loan AUM reaching the INR 29,000-31,000 crore target by March 2027.
Reduction of 3PL origination to 3.5% within the next six months.
Deployment of 600-plus autonomous AI agents across operations by FY27 end.

claims.claim: Stage 2 increase in gold loans was due to short-tenure schemes; 550 crores already resolved.
claims.quote: It actually includes a 1,047 crores increase in Stage 2 in the gold loan business, due to the short tenure schemes that we have actually launched... 550 crores has already been resolved and has flown back to Stage 1.

claims.claim: Raising capital via QIP and warrants is principally driven by the growth story of India and the company.
claims.quote: The Board's decision of raising additional capital is principally driven by mainly growth story of India and of the company and its subsidiaries.

claims.claim: Management reduced 3PL origination from 14% to 7% and targets 3.5% in 6 months.
claims.quote: We have brought that down from 14% to 7% in terms of origination my mandate to the team is to bring that down to 3.5% in the 6 months' time.

claims.claim: Macroeconomic overlay of 337 crores was created as prudence and resilience for cyclicality.
claims.quote: The fundamental reason for creating overlay, let me articulate it not because we see stress building. I want us to remember always that this is bullet proofing of the business. It is for resilience.

claims.claim: AUM added a record INR37,000 crores in the quarter with strong profit growth of 28%
claims.quote: AUM, we added a record INR37,000 crores of AUM in a quarter. Profit growth was strong at 28% and ROE crossed 20% still there on account of BHFL dilution.

claims.claim: Loan loss to average AUF improved to 1.54% versus 1.87% in the previous comparable period
claims.quote: credit performance principally remained quite strong with loan loss to average AUF in the new frame that we talked about improving to 1.54% versus same time during the same period, 1.87%.

claims.claim: Expanding the AI unit from 230 to 400 people and adding 300 people in digital platforms
claims.quote: We're doubling down on Fin AI transformation. We're expanding the AI unit from 230 to 400 people. We're also adding another 300 people in digital platform unit.

claims.claim: The worst of credit issues in MSME is behind us by June 2026.
claims.quote: And I think in our assessment, the worst is behind us by June '26.

claims.claim: Entering FY27 with tailwinds on credit costs, providing strong navigating capacity.
claims.quote: I would just say the more important point or a meta point in this is we are entering the year on credit costs with tailwinds.

claims.claim: The business model is micro, not macro, and focuses on localized underwriting.
claims.quote: Our business is -- we know, but that you always remember our business is micro, not macro.

claims.claim: Management focuses on bulletproofing the balance sheet while delivering sustainable ROE.
claims.quote: We are, Sandeep made a point on bullet proofing the balance sheet. We will be a bulletproof business.

risks.text: Material related party transactions with subsidiary Bajaj Housing Finance Limited for aggregate amount not exceeding INR 18,152 crore.
Assessment of expected credit loss impairment allowance on loans involving significant management judgement.
